name: Jérémy Jacquet

career_stints.note: Professional debut 13 Jan 2024 vs Nice (as a substitute); limited first-team minutes before departing on loan to Clermont Foot on 29 Jan 2024.

Ligue 2, season-long-plus loan (late Jan 2024 - Feb 2025), recalled early by Rennes in February 2025. Spans parts of both the 2023/24 and 2024/25 French seasons and could not be split cleanly by season from available sources, so kept as one combined stint. Goals/assists not confirmed for this specific stint -- omitted rather than assumed zero.

Ligue 1 first-team run following recall from Clermont (1,673 minutes, 4 yellow cards, 1 red card per FotMob-derived stat line). Season cut short by a left shoulder injury sustained 7 Feb 2026 (vs Lens), which required surgery. Liverpool's deal for him was agreed in January 2026 while he was still a Rennes player.
Contract began 1 July 2026 after recovering from the Rennes shoulder injury ahead of pre-season. No competitive Liverpool minutes yet as of this profile's creation (2026-08-10).

notes: 20-year-old France U21 international; genuinely no Liverpool history, a real test case for the positional-logic rules similar to Muñoz's profile.

Transfer fee reporting varies slightly across sources (£55m per Sky Sports' initial report in January 2026, up to £60m including add-ons per other outlets) -- not fully reconciled; not part of this schema's fields anyway, so not asserted as a single number.

No current injury as of 2026-08-10 research -- the Rennes shoulder injury (surgery, Feb 2026) is reported as resolved ('recovered ahead of pre-season with Liverpool'), so injury_status is left null rather than carried forward as active.
Position listed as CB only in both the squad file and every source checked; no secondary position found.
Sources: liverpoolfc.com, skysports.com, thisisanfield.com, goal.com, transfermarkt.us, fotmob.com, whoscored.com, aol.com -- via web search 2026-08-10.
